name: Pinecone
free_plan_limits: 2 GB storage, 5 indexes, 1 project, AWS us-east-1 only
usage_note: $50 a month minimum, then $0.33 per GB stored, $16-18 per million reads
since_note: Came out of stealth with its vector database in January 2021; company founded 2019 (SiliconANGLE; Pinecone company page).
best_for: Hosted vector search with no servers to run
notes: $50 is a minimum usage charge; a small project may stay near it. 3-week trial with $300 credit. Hybrid flag from its sparse-embedding model listing. Enterprise has a $500 minimum.

name: Chroma
free_plan_limits: $5 of free credits, then pay for usage
usage_note: $2.50 per GiB written, $0.33 per GiB stored a month
best_for: Small projects and prototypes, free to self-host
notes: $0 is the base fee; you still pay usage after the $5 credit. Team plan is $250 a month with $100 credits. Self-hosting the open-source version costs nothing for the software.

name: Supabase pgvector
free_plan_limits: 500 MB database, 2 projects, pauses after 1 week of inactivity
usage_note: Includes $10 of compute; extra projects add compute from $10 a month
since_note: Supabase announced pgvector support in a blog post dated 6 February 2023 (Supabase blog).
best_for: Vectors next to your normal app database
notes: pgvector is a Postgres add-on, so vectors live with your other tables. Docs show keyword plus vector hybrid search. Self-host and open-source flags are not on the fetched pages; from Supabase's open-source positioning.

name: Qdrant
free_plan_limits: 1 node, 0.5 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 4 GB disk, free forever
usage_note: Billed hourly for CPU, memory and storage
best_for: Fast self-hosted or cloud vector search
notes: Not stated: Standard cloud has no listed starting price; cost depends on cluster size. The open-source version is free to self-host with community support only.

name: Weaviate
free_plan_limits: 1 cluster, 100,000 objects, 1 GB memory, 2,000 embedding requests a day
usage_note: From $45 a month, pay as you go on a shared cluster
best_for: Managed or self-hosted search with built-in AI tools
notes: $45 is the starting price; real cost grows with data. Premium contracts start around $400 a month. Cloud runs the open-source Weaviate project.
